SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Subject (in full) John M. Murray.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE Special Branch S.B. REGISTR. No. D 3703 Date June 12, 1932. Date 13 / 6 / 32.）

Made by D.S. Moore Forwarded by [签名]

Enquiries made in connection with the above
named reveal that he is an unregistered married American
citizen and a native of Seattle in which city his wife
resides. He is believed to have resided for some years
in Canton, but so far as is known did not take up residence
in this city until March 1932, when he is believed to have
come Here from Mukden. From March 15 to May 15 of this
year he was in occupation of quarters in a boarding house
situated at 606 Avenue Joffre and which is now conducted
by a Mrs. Lydia Kojinoff. Murray was originally taken to
this address by a Russian Jew of about 40 years of age and
was later visited on two or three occasions by a Mrs. C. J.
Kushner (American) the wife of a Russian employee at
Whiteaway Laidlaw and Co. It appears that Murray numbers
amongst his acquaintances in America the mother of Mrs.
Kushner. About the middle of May, Murray was absent from
his lodgings for three days. At the end of that period,
a Russian female of about 30 years of age who had been in
the habit of visiting him almost daily, called at the house
stating that Murray was a patient in the Country Hospital
and that she was authorised by him to remove his effects
to a new address which she omitted to give. Permission
to remove his baggage, which was composed of leather and
steel trunks, was given and carried into effect. It has
now been discovered that Murray is residing at 111 Route
Vallon, but whether he took up residence at that address
immediately following the vacating of his quarters at 606
Avenue Joffre, is difficult to say.

报告
事由（全称）约翰·M·默里 (John M. Murray)。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别支部 S.B. 登记号 D 3703 日期 1932年6月12日。日期 1932年6月13日。）

制作人 D.S. 穆尔 (Moore) 转呈人 [签名]

就上述姓名之人进行的查询显示，其为一名未登记的已婚美国公民，原籍西雅图，其妻居住于该市。据信他曾在广州居住数年，但据所知，他直到1932年3月才在本市定居，据信他是从沈阳来到此处的。今年3月15日至5月15日期间，他居住在霞飞路606号的一家寄宿公寓内，该公寓现由莉迪亚·科吉诺夫 (Lydia Kojinoff) 女士经营。默里最初是由一名约40岁的俄籍犹太人带至该地址的，后来C.J.库什纳 (Kushner) 女士（美国人，怀特威·莱德劳公司 (Whiteaway Laidlaw and Co.) 一名俄籍职员的妻子）曾两三次前往拜访。据悉，默里在美国的熟人中包括库什纳女士的母亲。5月中旬左右，默里离开住所三天。在此期间结束时，一名约30岁、习惯几乎每日拜访他的俄国女子来到寓所，称默里是乡村医院 (Country Hospital) 的病人，并声称已获默里授权将其物品搬至一个新地址，但她未透露该地址。当局准许搬走其行李（由皮革和钢制行李箱组成），并已执行。现已查明，默里居住在法伦路 (Route Vallon) 111号，但他是否在搬离霞飞路606号的住所后立即入住该地址，则难以断言。

such a service exists in Vancouver, with a Mr. Sievertz as
President and that correspondence has passed between the
local Canadian Government Trade Commissioner and the
Secretary of the Canadian Manufacturers Association on the
subject of news transmission and a closer co-operation
between Reuters and the "Pacific News Service" in Vancouver,
but the local office of Reuters are unaware of the existence
of John Murray in connection with the above. Local press
and news agency circles are likewise ignorant concerning
Murray's claim to be correspondent for the "Pacific News
Service". According to a report rendered by a detective
attached to S.B., Murray has on one occasion, whilst resident
at 606 Avenue Joffre, visited by one Edmond Egon Kisch, a
German journalist and correspondent of the "Prager Tagblatt"
who is also believed to be a correspondent for the German
communist newspaper "Rote Fahne."

Murray is reputed to be able to converse fluently
in German and Chinese as well as English and is also credited
with a knowledge of the Russian language. His description
is as follows :- Age about 35 years, about 5' 10" in
height, black hair, bald on top of the head, small moustache,
round face.

SPECIAL INQUIRY
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3703.
9 / 6 / 32.
Translation of extracts from French Police Daily
Intelligence Report dated May 30, 1932.

Para.1. Activity of M. Murray
We are informed that one John Murray, special
correspondent of the "Pacific News Agency Ltd"
(Vancouver, B.C. Canada) recently entered into
relations with E.E. Kisch, Czechoslovakian journalist,
one of the founders of the "Society of Friends of the
USSR at Shanghai". John Murray speaks English,
German and Chinese fluently, and also speaks a little
Russian. He has been in Shanghai for about a month.
According to information available, the "Pacific News
Agency Ltd" is a socialistic agency working in a
close contact with the Third International.

Para.22. Appearance of Red Riflemen at Pootung
At 8 p.m. on May 29 about 20 men styling themselves
as "Red Riflemen" shot with revolvers and fatally
wounded a militiaman in the employ of the Yangching town
(Pootung). Despite the immediate intervention of
members of the 2nd sub-station of the Public Safety
Bureau of the 3rd District, none of the assassins has
been arrested.

Release of two Koreans implicated in the Hongkew
Park Bombing Affair
Supplementary to our previous information, we
learn that PARK CHE TO (Korean Pronunciation) or PAO
TSI TAO (Chinese pronunciation) and CHANG SANG KOOK
(Korean pronunciation) or CHANG HSIANG KIO (Chinese
pronunciation), arrested on April 30, 1932 by the
Japanese Consular Police with the assistance of members
of our Political Section, on a charge of being concerned
in the Hongkew Park bombing affair (vide our report
dated April 30, 1932, appendix p.3), were released
on May 29.

1932年6月9日。
翻译自1932年5月30日法国警察每日情报报告的摘录。

第1段. M. 默里的活动
据告，约翰·默里，“太平洋新闻社有限公司”（加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华）的特派记者，最近与捷克斯洛伐克记者E.E.基施建立了联系，后者是“上海苏联之友社”的创始人之一。约翰·默里能流利地说英语、德语和汉语，也会说一点俄语。他在上海已待了大约一个月。根据现有信息，“太平洋新闻社有限公司”是一个社会主义性质的机构，与第三国际保持密切联系。

第22段. 浦东出现赤色步枪手
5月29日晚8时，约20名自称“赤色步枪手”的人用手枪射击，并致命击伤了一名受雇于杨泾镇（浦东）的民团成员。尽管第三区公共安全局第二分署成员立即介入，但刺客无一被捕。

释放两名卷入虹口公园爆炸案的朝鲜人
补充我们之前的信息，我们获悉，朴基道 (PARK CHE TO)（朝鲜语发音）或鲍志道 (PAO TSI TAO)（中文发音）和张相国 (CHANG SANG KOOK)（朝鲜语发音）或张湘乔 (CHANG HSIANG KIO)（中文发音），这两人于1932年4月30日由日本领事警察在我们政治股成员的协助下，以涉嫌参与虹口公园爆炸案为由逮捕（参见我们1932年4月30日的报告，附录第3页），已于5月29日获释。

Para 1 Activity of J.Murray.

Supplementary to the information given in our yesterday's report,
page 1, parag.1, we learn that J.Murray, correspondent of the "Paci-

We are further informed that J.Murray went to the offices of the
"China Forum", pro-communist journal ( No.19 Museum Road) and the
"Tass News Agency" ( No 20 Museum Road ) on two or three occasi-
ons. It is reported that in the course of these visits he had in-
terviews with V.Rover, Manager of this agency and an agent of the
Comintern.

It seems that J.Murray is anxious to conceal the fact of his vi-
siting V.Rover.

翻译自1932年5月31日法国警察每日情报报告的摘录

第1段 J.默里的活动。

补充我们昨日报告第1页第1段所提供的信息，我们获悉，“太平洋新闻社有限公司”记者J.默里最近数次访问位于静安寺路435号的“时代精神书店”(Zeitgeist Book Store)，在那里他会见了著名的美国无政府主义-工团主义者艾格尼丝·史沫特莱 (Agnes Smedley) 女士。

我们还获悉，J.默里曾两三次前往亲共刊物《中国论坛》(China Forum) 的办公室（博物馆路19号）以及塔斯社 (Tass News Agency)（博物馆路20号）。据报道，在这些访问期间，他会见了该社经理V.罗弗 (Rover)，后者也是共产国际的一名特工。

看来J.默里急于隐瞒他拜访V.罗弗的事实。

S2.
请归档至
相应档案。
JG
1932年6月2日

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3703.
Date 2 / 6 / 32.

EXTRACTS FROM THE FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT.

May 31, 1932.

THE ACTIVITIES OF J. MURRAY.

In continuation of our report of May 30, page 1
paragraph 1, we learn that the man named J. Murray,
correspondent of the Pacific News Service Ltd. paid
several calls during the last few days at the Zeitgeist
Book Store, No. 425 Bubbling Well Road, where he used
to meet Mrs. Agnes Smedley, a notorious American
anarchist and syndicalist.

We also learn that Murray has paid two or three
visits to the editor of the Pro-Communist paper called
the "China Forum", No. 19 Museum Road, and also at the
Tass News Agency, No. 20 Museum Road. During these
visits he had several interviews with V. Rover, Director
of this agency and an agent of the Comintern. It would
appear that Murray is endeavouring to conceal his visits
to Rover.

S2,
For inquiry and
report please.
[Signature]
1/6/32.

O.J. More
[Signature]
2/6/32.

EXTRACTS FROM THE FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT
------------------------------------------------------
                        May 30th, 1952
                        --------------

We are informed that one John Murray, special correspondent
of the "Pacific News Agency Ltd" (Vancouver, B.C. Canada)
recently entered into relations with E.E. Kisch, Czechoslovakian
journalist, one of the founders of the "Society of Friends of
the U.S.S.R. at Shanghai". John Murray speaks English, German
and Chinese fluently and also speaks a little Russian. He has
been in Shanghai for about a month. According to information
available, the "Pacific News Agency Ltd" is a socialistic
agency working in close contact with the Third International.

法国警察情报报告摘录
------------------------------------------------------
                        1952年5月30日
                        --------------

据告，约翰·默里，“太平洋新闻社有限公司”（加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华）的特派记者，最近与捷克斯洛伐克记者E.E.基施建立了联系，后者是“上海苏联之友社”的创始人之一。约翰·默里能流利地说英语、德语和汉语，也会说一点俄语。他在上海已待了大约一个月。根据现有信息，“太平洋新闻社有限公司”是一个社会主义性质的机构，与第三国际保持密切联系。

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. REGISTRY File No. D 3703 Special Branch Station, Date June 23, 1932）

Subject (in full) Watch maintained at 111 Route Vallon June 21 and 22, 1932.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by [签名]

The watch maintained on the house of John M. Murray during the day June 21, was unproductive of result as he was not seen at all neither did anyone visit him during that period.

Enquiries made in connection with private ricsha No. 6652 reveal that it is licensed in the name of one Wong Tuck Tai (王德泰), 104 Joo Huk Li (和合里), Sinza Road but endeavours to locate this address have proved abortive as the said alleyway simply does not exist on Sinza Road. When application is made for a private ricsha license, the applicants are free to give exactly what address they choose no attempts at verification being made.

The watch was again maintained on June 22, without result, Murray not being seen outside the house during the whole period.

D.S. Moore
D. S. [签名]

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：I suggest this watch be discontinued. [签名] 23/6/32.）

（批：Approved. [签名] O. i/c Sp. Br. JUNE 23 1932）

（批：As above, documents return to Registry [签名] 24/6/32. NOTED D.B.M 24/6）

Subject (in full) Watch on movements of John M. Murray June 15, 1932.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by O.L.O. Forrest.

As directed by the Officer i/c Special Branch, the
movements of John M. Murray who is residing at 111 Route Vallon,
have been watched. The watch commenced during the morning of
June 15 and from that time until 3.30 p.m. apart from 3 or 4
Chinese, both male and female of the servant type who were seen
entering or leaving the premises, nothing of importance occurred.
At the latter time, Murray left the house and entered the French
Park where he stayed until 5.30 p.m. then returned home.
He was not seen out again up to 6.30 p.m. when the watch was
terminated.

// Watch being maintained on June 16.

W.B. Moore

事由（全称）：1932年6月15日对约翰·M·默里（John M. Murray）行动的监视。

制作人：D.S. 穆尔。呈报人：O.L.O. 福雷斯特。

遵照特别分部主管警官的指示，对居住在瓦隆路111号的约翰·M·默里的行动进行了监视。监视于6月15日上午开始，从那时起至下午3时30分，除看到三至四名男女仆役模样的华人进出该处所外，未发生其他重要情况。
在此时刻，默里离开住所，进入法国公园（French Park），逗留至下午5时30分后返回家中。
直至下午6时30分监视终止时，未再见到其外出。

// 6月16日继续实施监视。

W.B. 穆尔
侦探警长

特别分部主管警官。

S2，请适时提交进一步报告。
O.L.O.F.
